meta.display: The River Road — travel-loop reskin v0.1
meta.notes: world-2 level 1 (iter-112, the reskin day): a TRAVEL-loop pack on the open generic stack (SRD 5.1 nouns — CC-BY-4.0, CREDITS.md sidecar), scaffolded from tavern_pack (ids stay, surfaces renamed — the scaffold law). The player journeys between the five waypoints of the river road; st-6a's derived travel prices make geography mechanical (rules.json travel block). Every value is pack data, never code (INV-3). Display names in English (D-009).

locations.name: the ferry inn
locations.role: main scene: common room, jetty door
locations.notes: timbered house on the river bank — the arson target; the storm lantern rides the journeys (MVP_SCOPE §3 shape)

locations.name: the river road
locations.role: the travel spine: journeys start and land here
locations.notes: open ground along the bank: no sight lines into interiors

locations.name: the stockade yard
locations.role: fire source spot; origin of the 'figure at the jetty door' rumor
locations.notes: behind the inn; the lantern is dropped here in the walkthrough

locations.name: the tollhouse
locations.role: watch change → knowledge transfer between tollmen
locations.notes: off-duty post; knowledge transfer fires here at rotation ticks (rules.json); the hearth post — the other lit room

locations.name: the ferry quay
locations.role: the rumor scene (mandatory: this is where hearsay lives)
locations.notes: day-phase activity hub; the throng listener lives here

npcs.name: the wayfarer
npcs.goal: deliver, collect, stay ahead of the toll
npcs.notes: starts on the road and travels the loop; crime_status is the crime_watch convention (rules.json crime_watch.status_values)

npcs.name: Odo
npcs.notes: stands at the counter (walkthrough §3); pickpocket target; ev_0007 actor-side witness; expects the toll purse on himself (rules.expectations)

npcs.name: the relief tollman
npcs.notes: receives Odo's knowledge at watch change (transfer event); pair trust 75 — colleagues (P2a, D-020); the pair.pc_01.suspicion home (suspectaxis-2, D-102)

npcs.name: the innkeeper
npcs.notes: heard-vague witness in ev_0007; cudgel is under the counter

npcs.name: the drunk boatman
npcs.notes: intoxication 50 (v0.1 default): testimony vague by construction (§6 intersection matrix); tomorrow's rumor teller (ev_0031)

npcs.name: the ferry girl
npcs.notes: moves between counter, benches and jetty door (same-location roaming)

ambient_entities.name: the quay throng
ambient_entities.notes: passive knowledge-holder and rumor listener (MVP_SCOPE §4.2): no goals, no relations, no movement — receives knowledge records only

items.name: the storm lantern
items.notes: fire source; breakable — the drop_break target that starts the arson chain

items.name: the toll purse
items.notes: owned by Odo; the steal target (ev_0007)

items.name: the jug of mead
items.notes: intoxication vector — feeds the boatman's witness quality
